subject.title: Feature request: Mid-stream message injection (soft steer)

question: Should this issue remain the broad pause-or-abort/resume soft-steer product tracker while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/48003 owns the concrete ordinary-message boundary-steering regression?
rationale: Source inspection shows a partial fix on main and a narrower open canonical path, but only maintainers can decide whether the broader Manus-style pause/resume lifecycle is an accepted OpenClaw product direction or should be collapsed into boundary steering.

options.title: Keep Split Trackers
options.body: Use this issue for broad soft-steer lifecycle semantics and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/48003 for the concrete ordinary-message admission regression.

options.title: Collapse To Canonical Bug
options.body: Close this issue later as superseded only after maintainers copy the broader pause/resume requirements into the canonical active-run steering tracker.

options.title: Document Boundary Steering Only
options.body: Declare that OpenClaw supports boundary steering plus interrupt mode for now and defer true pause/resume soft steering to a future sponsored design.

recommendation.title: Keep Split Trackers
recommendation.body: Use this issue for broad soft-steer lifecycle semantics and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/48003 for the concrete ordinary-message admission regression.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current signal across active steering, session-state tradeoffs, and maintainer-owned follow-up decisions.
